title: Desk Guidance: The Last Day of Collection When a Cash Pickup Recipient Name Is Corrected
content:
## Rule

A name correction on a Cash Pickup transfer keeps the pickup window as it stands and adds no days to it.

## What that means for the transfer

- The last day of collection after the correction is the same date as before it, so the days by which a correction moves the last day of collection are zero.
- The days left are the calendar days from the day of the correction to the current last day of collection, the correction day not counted. They are the same after the correction as before it.

## Illustration (hypothetical transfers)

A transfer whose last day of collection is 20 June has its recipient name corrected on 12 June. The days left are 8, and after the correction the last day is still 20 June, with 8 days left.

A transfer whose last day is 3 July is corrected on 3 July. The days left are 0, and the last day stays 3 July.
